use_cases: Primary call-to-action buttons on landing pages and marketing sites
Interactive form submission buttons with visual feedback
Highlighted action buttons in dashboard interfaces
Stylized navigation buttons with gradient aesthetics
E-commerce product detail page purchase buttons
ai_summary: A versatile gradient button component with support for multiple color variants (emerald, purple, orange) and both light and dark themes. Features sophisticated gradient borders, glow effects, and hover states for enhanced visual feedback. Built as a React component extending standard HTML button attributes, making it easy to integrate into any React application.
